node: High-end MLCCs for AI server boards and rack-scale accelerator systems
summary: This Layer 1B pass expands the US-tradable universe around high-end MLCCs used on dense AI accelerator/server boards. The node appears concentrated in a narrow technical subset: small, high-capacitance, low-ESR/low-ESL MLCCs and adjacent low-inductance capacitor architectures for GPU, CPU, FPGA, ASIC, voltage-regulation, and power-delivery networks. The strongest evidence supports Japanese/Korean reference leaders such as Murata, Samsung Electro-Mechanics, TDK, and Kyocera AVX. The underfollowed US-listed discovery lane is thin; Vishay is the most plausible direct small/mid-cap candidate, while Arrow is a second-order distributor/inventory-signal candidate rather than a producer. Most non-leader candidates should remain hypotheses until product-grade, customer, and AI-server qualification evidence is verified.
